name: sc_aggregate_render_mesh_shader
desc: Using mesh shaders if available instead of drawcalls

name: cl_phys_assume_fixed_tick_interval
desc: If true, we assume the client uses a fixed tickrate like the server (which may not always be true). If false, we recalculate the number of physics substeps in each client tick based on the actual elapsed time in the tick.
example: cl_phys_assume_fixed_tick_interval          "false"         // Assume the client uses a fixed tickrate like the server (which may not always be true)actual [def: "true"]

name: r_citadel_distancefield_min_screen_space_size
desc: Minimum screen space size before culling

name: r_particle_timescale
example: r_particle_timescale                        "1.1"           // Speeds up particle simulation, thus making them end sooner, however this causes visual desyncs, most notably with big effects that last a while such as infernus ult. Please tweak this to what you are comfortable with. [def: "1"]

name: snd_occlusion_rays
example: snd_occlusion_rays                          "0"             // Occlusion bounces, this effectively disables them.               [def: "4"]

name: ai_think_interval_lod_med
desc: Time interval between NPC thinks when set to AI LOD medium.

name: citadel_camera_hard_trace_radius
desc: The radius of the cylinder to trace for hard camera occlusion.

name: citadel_camera_parrot_smoothing_rate
desc: When the camera stops being clipped, smooth the motion back to the desired resting position.
example: "citadel_camera_parrot_smoothing_rate" "0"   // Stops the camera from running math to "smooth" itself back into place after hitting a wall.

name: citadel_radial_distortion
desc: 0: Off 1: Distorts the visible distribution of arcs based on the mouse pointer.

name: citadel_show_chat_wheel_angle_threshold
desc: (degrees) Increase this to change how much you have to move your camera angle to make the Chat Wheel instantly visible while holding Ping.

name: cloth_ground_plane_thickness
desc: Raise ground by this much for all cloth that traces the ground; should be 0 ideally

name: lb_shadow_texture_height_override
desc: Override height of shadow atlas texture
example: "lb_shadow_texture_height_override" "16"         // Shrinks the global shadow atlas to 16 pixels

name: lb_shadow_texture_width_override
desc: Override width of shadow atlas texture
example: "lb_shadow_texture_width_override" "16"          // Shrinks the global shadow atlas to 16 pixels

name: panorama_draw_text_fast_path
example: "panorama_draw_text_fast_path" "1"              // Forces text rendering through a hardware fast-path

name: panorama_draw_text_fast_path_text_shadow
example: "panorama_draw_text_fast_path_text_shadow" "1"  // Forces text shadows through a hardware fast-path

name: panorama_enable_secondary_layout_pass
example: "panorama_enable_secondary_layout_pass" "0"     // Skips the secondary CSS layout check (drastically reduces UI calculation time)

name: panorama_hsbc_through_fast_path
example: "panorama_hsbc_through_fast_path" "1"           // Forces UI hue/saturation/brightness changes through a fast-path

name: panorama_script_cache_enabled
desc: Enable script caching to speed up recompiling scripts multiple times.
example: "panorama_script_cache_enabled" "1"             // Aggressively caches UI Javascript to prevent mid-game recompilation

name: panorama_use_backbuffer_directly
example: "panorama_use_backbuffer_directly" "1"          // Skips copying the UI buffer to memory and writes directly to the backbuffer

name: r_texture_nonstreaming_load
desc: Allow immediately loading mips of textures (when possible) when their headers are loaded, saving IO & reducing latency.

name: rtx_dynamic_blas_caching
desc: Cache dynamic BLAS if geometry has not changed

name: rtx_texture_resolution
desc: Sets the texture resolution the raytracer will mark to stream in

name: sc_aggregate_indirect_draw_compaction_threshold
desc: Threshold of indirect draws when we will do compaction

name: sc_barnlight_enable_precomputed_vis
desc: Enable use of precomputed vis membership for lights (requires map restart)

name: sc_disable_culling_boxes
example: "sc_disable_culling_boxes" "1"       // Skips calculating bounding boxes for culling

name: panorama_worldpanel_update_culling
example: //panorama_worldpanel_update_culling              "true"        // Messes with health bar rendering. it is weird.   [def: "false"]

name: r_pipeline_stats_flush_before_sleeping
desc: Experimental: Set to 1 to enable GPU pipeline flushes right before the render thread sleeps to wait for more work.

name: sc_aggregate_show_outside_vis
example: //sc_aggregate_show_outside_vis                   "true"        //this makes the entire map stop rendering          [def: "false"]

name: fs_async_threads
desc: Number of IO threads in async filesystem (-1 == auto)

name: lb_enable_envmaps
example: // lb_enable_envmaps                         "0"             // Gives fps but fucks up lighting

name: r_dopixelvisibility
example: // r_dopixelvisibility                       "false"         // Default true, enables or disables pixel visibility calculations

name: r_extra_render_frames
example: //r_extra_render_frames                     "1"             // Setting this to anything above 0 causes issues with latency. negative values cause the game to crash. [def: "0"]

name: sc_disable_world_materials
example: //"sc_disable_world_materials" "1"     // Turns the entire map gray (strips all materials from the world)

name: skeleton_instance_lod_optimization
desc: Compute LOD mask internally like since 2016, i.e. force all LOD groups' bones to compute
example: skeleton_instance_lod_optimization          "false"         // Compute LOD mask internally like since 2016, i.e. force all LOD groups' bones to compute [def: "false"]

name: r_flashlightambient
example: "r_flashlightambient" "0"            // Disables ambient lighting math on flashlights/muzzle flashes

name: sc_aggregate_gpu_culling
desc: Toggles GPU culling of aggregate meshes

name: sc_instanced_mesh_gpu_culling
desc: Toggles GPU culling of instanced meshes

name: engine_allow_multiple_simulates_per_frame
desc: When the client is catching up in low frame rate situations, should we run client simulate more than once a frame?
example: // engine_allow_multiple_simulates_per_frame "false"         // Default false, not sure about this one so dont change it

name: sc_aggregate_debug_draw_meshlets_bounds
desc: Visualize meshlet bounds and cone axis. Mesh shader only.

name: sparseshadowtree_disable_add_layers
desc: Disable SST runtime layers, for debugging (will exclude geo that CAN render into SST if SST otherwise enabled)
example: "sparseshadowtree_disable_add_layers" "1"        // Completely breaks Sparse Shadow Tree layering
